programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: On a trip to the library with Father and Ian, Olivia hopes to renew her fantastic book so she can finish it. During story time the book goes missing and Olivia and Ian set off to find it. She just can't go home without knowing how the book ends!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia's favourite art teacher, Miss Davis, is getting married, and Olivia wants to find her the perfect wedding present. programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Grandma takes Olivia and Ian to a special beach, they're all shocked to find that Grandma's old friend Annette has built a huge fence blocking the best part of the beach. programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. / After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. / When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Disarmed and Dangerous When Mantha's arm falls off, her replacement limb turns out to be a monstrous tentacle! Frankenleftovers Casper gets a seemingly impossible class assignment—to create life!

But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakey's Cousins are coming to visit! For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harper's soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. / When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his “magic hat,” they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Marcus is having his first sleepover and Phoebe is concerned that Marcus may be nervous so Phoebe sets out to make sure he has the best first sleepover ever. / When Athena’s magical jump rope gets sucked up by the family’s new robot vacuum, she loses confidence in her abilities, only to learn that her real abilities are already inside her.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. / Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: Tag wants to bring her new neighbor, Scooch, to the Party in the Tree. programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight

programme.desc: The Strutter siblings hold a yard sale and babysit at the same time. Archibald races for a big prize: a lifetime supply of his favorite cereal.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing
programme.desc: Archibald takes an unexpected trip to outer space. When a yummy recipe goes missing, Archibald P.I. sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Mother is determined to take the perfect family Christmas photo – in the middle of the summer. With the help of a snow machine, Olivia takes it upon herself to bring a little Christmas spirit to the photograph, and to Francine's backyard beach party next door.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Francine comes along reluctantly on Olivia's family camping trip, and Olivia can't believe that anyone could be so unprepared for life in the great outdoors. But with a little hiking, bug-catching, and marshmallow roasting, Olivia is sure she can transform Francine from a novice to an expert camper.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks she's ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: There's a new girl in Olivia's class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia (the original Olivia) can't believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself “Pam,” Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: It’s Pandy’s birthday!! The dollhouse is throwing a surprise party for him! Gabby goes room to room preparing all his favorite things for the party, but when the big moment comes, Pandy drops his cake! Gabby consoles him and tells him it’s even better – now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide (an older Dew Drop) is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. / When a string breaks on Marcus’ piano before his recital and he can’t practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when they’re not around. / Harper needs a good night’s sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercat's potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: It’s Kate’s birthday and everyone in the habitat has something amazing planned- but Melman’s worried that his homemade/hoof-made gift won’t measure up. While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesn’t matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isn't until the gang winds up at the rats' nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns it's okay to say no.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s “fun-crastinating” puts the project in jeopardy. / Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch break Gilber’s ancient Golden Slipper, they embark on an adventure to a secret cave to retrieve the matching slipper. \ For community outreach day, the Race Cadets are paired with an elderly resident of Pawston. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny
programme.desc: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny
programme.desc: When the kids grow over-confident after beginning their training, they decide to intercept a distress call and sneak off without permission, only to land themselves in hot water

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny
programme.desc: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After the events of the Boss Baby 2 film, adult businessman Theodore Templeton is framed for embezzling from his company and forced to revert back to his old Boss Baby self and crash with his brother Tim. But to pull this off, he'll need to win over Tim's family into letting him stay, and convince Baby Corp to give him back his old job... which is currently held by his baby niece Tina.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Now that they’re officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowhere’s many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way they’re going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence they've collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Discovery Channel SD
programme.desc: Discovery Channel, the flagship network of Discovery Communications, is devoted to creating the highest quality non-fiction programming in the world and remains one of the most dynamic networks on television. First launched in 1985, Discovery Channel now reaches over 190 million subscribers in Asia-Pacific. Globally, Discovery Channel is one of the world’s most widely distributed television brands, reaching 416 million cumulative subscribers in 218 countries and territories in 45 languages. It offers viewers an engaging line-up of high-quality non-fiction entertainment from blue-chip nature, science and technology, ancient and contemporary history, adventure, cultural and topical documentaries.....

programme.title: KBS World SD
programme.desc: KBS World is a 24-hour family entertainment channel provided by KBS, the flagship public service broadcaster in Korea. KBS programs broadcast on KBS World a mere 1 day to 7 days after their first-run in Korean terrestrial channel. With 100% original programming by KBS, the channel broadcasts in Korean language along with multilingual subtitles. Currently available for 54 million households within 117 countries and for over 1700 hotels in 46 countries, KBS World is the definite source to feel, enjoy, and learn Asian culture. KBS World promises to do its best to bring pleasant and informative programs to the viewers. Always enjoyable TV, it is KBS World!

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: BBC World News is the BBC’s 24-hour international news and information channel. BBC World News provides breaking news, broader news stories, as well as award-winning current affairs series and documentaries. Renowned globally for integrity, impartiality and quality, these three defining factors have seen us grow to be the world’s most trusted news brand. Reaching over 450 million households in more than 200 countries and territories around the world, BBC World News content is also available in 1.9 million hotel rooms, on 214 cruise ships, 53 airlines, including 13 distributing the channel live inflight, 26 mobile phone platforms and online at bbc.com/news. For further information about BBC World News, please visit bbcworldnews.com.

programme.desc: BBC World News is the BBC’s 24-hour international news and information channel. Renowned globally for integrity, impartiality and quality, these three defining factors have seen us grow to be the world’s most trusted news brand. For further information about BBC World News, please visit bbcworldnews.com.

BBC World News provides breaking news, broader news stories, as well as award-winning current affairs series and documentaries. Renowned globally for integrity, impartiality and quality, these three defining factors have seen us grow to be the world’s most trusted news brand. Reaching over 450 million households in more than 200 countries and territories around the world, BBC World News content is also available in 1.9 million hotel rooms, on 214 cruise ships, 53 airlines, including 13 distributing the channel live inflight, 26 mobile phone platforms and online at bbc.com/news. For further information about BBC World News, please visit bbcworldnews.com.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: BBC World News is the BBC’s 24-hour international news and information channel. BBC World News provides breaking news, broader news stories, as well as award-winning current affairs series and documentaries. Renowned globally for integrity, impartiality and quality, these three defining factors have seen us grow to be the world’s most trusted news brand. Reaching over 450 million households in more than 200 countries and territories around the world, BBC World News content is also available in 1.9 million hotel rooms, on 214 cruise ships, 53 airlines, including 13 distributing the channel live inflight, 26 mobile phone platforms and online at bbc.com/news. For further information about BBC World News, please visit bbcworldnews.com.

programme.title: Food Network HD
programme.desc: Food Network is a unique lifestyle network that connects viewers to the power and joy of food. It is a trusted resource that strives to teach, inspire, empower and entertain viewers through engaging content hosted by authentic personalities, world-class chefs and culinary experts. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the network offers a mix of local original productions and global programming featuring kitchen competition, culinary adventure, instructional cooking and home entertaining. Food Network is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information available on www.foodnetworkasia.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/foodnetworkasia

programme.title: Food Network HD
programme.desc: Food Network is a unique lifestyle network that connects viewers to the power and joy of food. It is a trusted resource that strives to teach, inspire, empower and entertain viewers through engaging content hosted by authentic personalities, world-class chefs and culinary experts. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the network offers a mix of local original productions and global programming featuring kitchen competition, culinary adventure, instructional cooking and home entertaining. Food Network is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information available on www.foodnetworkasia.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/foodnetworkasia

programme.title: Food Network HD
programme.desc: Food Network is a unique lifestyle network that connects viewers to the power and joy of food. It is a trusted resource that strives to teach, inspire, empower and entertain viewers through engaging content hosted by authentic personalities, world-class chefs and culinary experts. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the network offers a mix of local original productions and global programming featuring kitchen competition, culinary adventure, instructional cooking and home entertaining. Food Network is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information available on www.foodnetworkasia.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/foodnetworkasia

programme.desc: An award winning, multi-platform 24-hour business and financial news network, Bloomberg Television provides continuous coverage of the people, companies and ideas that move global markets. In addition to live streaming to 310,000 Bloomberg Professional subscribers, Bloomberg Television also broadcasts in hotels, central banks, investment institutions, commercial banks, government offices, law firms, corporations and news organizations. Bloomberg Television is part of Bloomberg Media Group which offers an integrated array of business media: online, mobile, digital applications, television and business print products.

Broadcasting from centers in New York, London, Hong Kong and Singapore and powered with an unparalleled news gathering team of 2,300 news professionals in 146 bureaus across 72 countries worldwide, Bloomberg Television delivers real-time business news to over 310 million households globally. In addition to live streaming to 310,000 Bloomberg Professional subscribers, Bloomberg Television also broadcasts in hotels, central banks, investment institutions, commercial banks, government offices, law firms, corporations and news organizations. Bloomberg Television is part of Bloomberg Media Group which offers an integrated array of business media: online, mobile, digital applications, television and business print products.

Broadcasting from centers in New York, London, Hong Kong and Singapore and powered with an unparalleled news gathering team of 2,300 news professionals in 146 bureaus across 72 countries worldwide, Bloomberg Television delivers real-time business news to over 310 million households globally. In addition to live streaming to 310,000 Bloomberg Professional subscribers, Bloomberg Television also broadcasts in hotels, central banks, investment institutions, commercial banks, government offices, law firms, corporations and news organizations. Bloomberg Television is part of Bloomberg Media Group which offers an integrated array of business media: online, mobile, digital applications, television and business print products.

programme.title: Asian Food Network
programme.desc: Asian Food Network is the region’s leading food-focused channel that celebrates the unique Asian culinary experience with the added touch of global flavor. AFN entertains viewers with a range of local and international content from reality, lifestyle to travelogue program formats. It believes in celebrating the rich history and story behind Asia’s most beloved cuisines and continues to grow its library of originally produced Asian content, breaking boundaries with new and exciting programs. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the channel’s online engagement via website and social media platforms surpass two million likes on Facebook and continues to increase daily. Asian Food Channel is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information is available on www.asianfoodchannel.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/asianfoodchannel

programme.title: Asian Food Network
programme.desc: Asian Food Network is the region’s leading food-focused channel that celebrates the unique Asian culinary experience with the added touch of global flavor. AFN entertains viewers with a range of local and international content from reality, lifestyle to travelogue program formats. It believes in celebrating the rich history and story behind Asia’s most beloved cuisines and continues to grow its library of originally produced Asian content, breaking boundaries with new and exciting programs. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the channel’s online engagement via website and social media platforms surpass two million likes on Facebook and continues to increase daily. Asian Food Channel is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information is available on www.asianfoodchannel.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/asianfoodchannel

programme.title: Asian Food Network
programme.desc: Asian Food Network is the region’s leading food-focused channel that celebrates the unique Asian culinary experience with the added touch of global flavor. AFN entertains viewers with a range of local and international content from reality, lifestyle to travelogue program formats. It believes in celebrating the rich history and story behind Asia’s most beloved cuisines and continues to grow its library of originally produced Asian content, breaking boundaries with new and exciting programs. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the channel’s online engagement via website and social media platforms surpass two million likes on Facebook and continues to increase daily. Asian Food Channel is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information is available on www.asianfoodchannel.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/asianfoodchannel

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior (Season 15)
programme.desc: Season 15 of “American Ninja Warrior” returns with the most elite athletes in the country competing on the world’s most difficult obstacle courses. Hosts Matt Iseman and Akbar Gbajabiamila, along with co-host Zuri Hall, are back to call the action as the ninjas make their way through the qualifying and semifinal rounds in Los Angeles before moving to the national finals in Las Vegas. With the biggest changes in show history, Season 15 will challenge the ninjas to race side-by-side and head-to-head across a high-stakes course with a spot in the national finals on the line. Additionally, the Mega Wall is even taller than before at 18½ feet and, for the first time ever, ninjas will need to complete all six obstacles in a designated time in order to earn a shot at the $10,000 prize. Also at stake is a top prize of $1 million for the fastest ninja who can conquer all four stages at the national finals.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior (Season 15)
programme.desc: Season 15 of “American Ninja Warrior” returns with the most elite athletes in the country competing on the world’s most difficult obstacle courses. Hosts Matt Iseman and Akbar Gbajabiamila, along with co-host Zuri Hall, are back to call the action as the ninjas make their way through the qualifying and semifinal rounds in Los Angeles before moving to the national finals in Las Vegas. With the biggest changes in show history, Season 15 will challenge the ninjas to race side-by-side and head-to-head across a high-stakes course with a spot in the national finals on the line. Additionally, the Mega Wall is even taller than before at 18½ feet and, for the first time ever, ninjas will need to complete all six obstacles in a designated time in order to earn a shot at the $10,000 prize. Also at stake is a top prize of $1 million for the fastest ninja who can conquer all four stages at the national finals.

programme.desc: Alamin kung paano gumamit ng magagalang na pananalita, salitang naglalarawan, at angkop na tanong. Alamin rin ang mga salitang magkatugma, pagkukumpara ng kuwento at pagbibigay ng wakas dito.

programme.title: Grade 3 Math
programme.desc: Learn multiplication and division of whole numbers including money.

programme.title: Grade 3 English
programme.desc: Know more about verbs, pronouns, consonant blends, and digraphs, as well as different sources of information and how to identify facts and opinions.

programme.title: Grade 3 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Matutong unawain at pahalagahan ang iba’t ibang kwento at mga sagisag na naglalarawan ng sariling lalawigan at mga karatig lalawigan sa kinabibilangang rehiyon.

programme.title: Grade 3 Science
programme.desc: Discover the parts and functions of the sense organs of the human body; parts and functions of animals and plants and their importance to humans; the characteristics of living and nonliving things and the basic needs of plants, animals and humans.

programme.title: Grade 7 Filipino
programme.desc: Alamin ang mga antas ng wika at mga salitang may kinalaman sa paghahambing, pati na rin ang pagsusulat at pagsusuri ng awitin at editoryal na sulatin.

programme.title: Grade 7 Math
programme.desc: Learn about key concepts of measurement, algebraic expressions, the properties of real numbers as applied in linear equations, and inequalities in one variable.

programme.title: Grade 7 English
programme.desc: Know more about listening strategies, navigating websites, and using search engines, as well as summarizing key information, doing research, using analogy, and transcoding information.

programme.title: Grade 7 Araling Panlipunan
programme.desc: Aralin ang kaisipang Asyano, pilosopiya, at relihiyon na nagbigay daan sa paghubog ng sinaunang kabihasnan sa Asya at sa pagbuo ng pagkakakilanlang Asyano.

programme.title: Grade 7 Science
programme.desc: Differentiate the parts and functions of the compound microscope and the different levels of biological organization, alongside the comparison between animal and plant cells, reproduction, and interaction between organisms.

Nickelodeon SD
programme.desc: Nickelodeon, now in its 38th year, is the number-one entertainment brand for kids. It has built a diverse, global business by putting kids first in everything it does. The company includes television programming and production in the United States and around the world, plus special events, consumer products, digital, recreation, books and feature films. Nickelodeon's brands reach 1.1 billion cumulative subscribers in more than 170 countries and territories, via more than 80+ locally programmed channels and branded blocks. Outside of the United States, Nickelodeon is part of Viacom International Media Networks, a division of Viacom Inc. (NASDAQ: VIAB, VIA), one of the world’s leading creators of programming and content across all media platforms. For more information about Nickelodeon in Asia, visit www.nick-asia.com.

The company includes television programming and production in the United States and around the world, plus special events, consumer products, digital, recreation, books and feature films. Nickelodeon's brands reach 1.1 billion cumulative subscribers in more than 170 countries and territories, via more than 80+ locally programmed channels and branded blocks. Outside of the United States, Nickelodeon is part of Viacom International Media Networks, a division of Viacom Inc. (NASDAQ: VIAB, VIA), one of the world’s leading creators of programming and content across all media platforms. For more information about Nickelodeon in Asia, visit www.nick-asia.com.

programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior (Season 15)
programme.desc: Season 15 of “American Ninja Warrior” returns with the most elite athletes in the country competing on the world’s most difficult obstacle courses. Hosts Matt Iseman and Akbar Gbajabiamila, along with co-host Zuri Hall, are back to call the action as the ninjas make their way through the qualifying and semifinal rounds in Los Angeles before moving to the national finals in Las Vegas. With the biggest changes in show history, Season 15 will challenge the ninjas to race side-by-side and head-to-head across a high-stakes course with a spot in the national finals on the line. Additionally, the Mega Wall is even taller than before at 18½ feet and, for the first time ever, ninjas will need to complete all six obstacles in a designated time in order to earn a shot at the $10,000 prize. Also at stake is a top prize of $1 million for the fastest ninja who can conquer all four stages at the national finals.
